scope: Extend the existing maintenance BOT to diagnose employee behavior and collaboration history, compare bounded role-prompt changes, and publish review-only organizational design proposals.

fullSuiteBeforeFinalTwoCases.failure: Temporal ephemeral executable startup exceeded five seconds. A prior run also had download failures; these were environment setup failures, not assertion failures.

temporalRepair.change: Reuse the same cached SDK executable as existing Temporal tests; keep each server and history isolated.

verifiedPaths: Owner-scoped 30-day creation cohorts, status/retry aggregates, delegation edges, bounded evidence and secret-pattern omission
Frozen evaluation criteria and recorded-request digests checked before patch and replay
Same-model, same-context paired prompt responses with target improvement and control preservation required
Failed and inconclusive comparisons prevent publication
Restart after durable response but before checkpoint reuses the same response without a new model call
Human-work priority, shared company budget and revoked-owner checks
Organizational proposals create generated document-only PRs and explicitly unverified Slack outbox notices
Documentation evaluation cannot validate runtime or role changes
Regression gate runs the same cases on exact parent and candidate, rejecting errors, skips, removed cases and unchanged failures
CI timeout starts at candidate publication, allowing a budgeted evaluation to span multiple days

testClassification.postgresql: real disposable local databases and CI service
testClassification.temporal: real ephemeral server and workflow history replay
testClassification.regressionComparison: real temporary Git repositories and pytest subprocesses
testClassification.model: scripted fixtures; no actual subscription replay was invoked
testClassification.githubBroker: HTTP fixtures; this implementation PR was published by the main coding session
testClassification.slack: durable outbox assertions; no maintenance message was sent to live Slack

limitations: Paired replay checks two saved requests once per version and only explicit decision properties; it does not establish broad quality, financial expertise or statistical improvement.
The history counts are diagnostic signals, not quality scores or causal proof.
Whole-company conversation replay and autonomous organization/permission/model reconfiguration are not implemented; those changes become design-review proposals.
notRun: GitHub App installation and an actual BOT-generated PR
Production maintenance profile activation and additional memory measurement
